title: sdr daily scratchpad - elena zhou - 2026-03-12
content:
Morning plan / priorities:
- 9:00–10:30: Cold call block (list A) — focus on MQLs from last 7 days
- 11:00: Seq review with Jordan (15m) — swap templates for fintech vertical
- 1:30–3:00: Follow-up emails + demo scheduling
- 3:15–4:00: Enterprise inbound follow-ups (AE handoffs)
- 4:30: End-of-day notes + update CRM

Daily targets:
- Calls: 40 (outbound)
- Connects: 8+
- Meetings booked: 3
- Demos to qualify for AE: 2

List A (priority cold calls) — quick notes + warm hooks:
1) Park Financial / Ana Martinez — CTO (lead from webinar)
   - Why call: demo interest -> asked about latency guarantees
   - If connects: ask about current inference infra, pains on latency/cost, mention Dedicated pools + SLA
   - Next step: book intro demo, send one-pager after call

2) QuantumRetail / Samir Patel — Head of AI
   - Lead from case study download; uses embeddings for search
   - Pain: token cost spikes during peak traffic
   - Pitch: Redwood Optimize + batching/kv caching to reduce unit cost
   - Objection prep: pricing detail (share high-level savings examples, defer exact numbers to AE)

3) NovaHealth / Rachel Kim — Director Data Science
   - Regulatory concerns (PHI) — highlight Private (VPC/on-prem) options + KMS
   - Ask: compliance needs, audit log reqs
   - Follow-up: send compliance one-pager + security contact info

Warm follow-ups / inbound queue:
- Acme Retail (inbound) — responded to initial email, wants pricing for 50k req/day. AE: Jordan. Status: waiting for Jordan to confirm availability for demo (slot Friday).
- Helix Labs — demo 3/9, post-demo notes: potential fit but needs model quantization examples. Action: send sample quantization profile + ROI calc (Elena)

Script snippets / hooks to use (short):
- "Hi X — quick q: are you seeing token-cost spikes during peak traffic? We’ve helped teams cut per-token costs by 20–50% without degrading quality by using batching + caching profiles."
- "If compliance is a blocker: we have Private deployments (VPC + on-prem) and KMS/HSM integrations for auditability."

Email templates (short):
- Follow-up after no answer:
  Subject: Quick follow-up on {company} + Redwood
  Body: "Hey {first}, circling back — did you get my note about reducing inference costs while keeping latency tight? Happy to share a short ROI snapshot specific to {company}. Are you free for 20m next week?"

Notes to self / tips:
- Use the fintech template for Park Financial; mention real example of batching improvements (cite internal benchmark: 30% latency improvement for seq len 512)
- Always log channel and disposition in CRM immediately after call (helps Jordan route)
- If prospect asks for pilot: propose 4-week POC on Dedicated with limited capacity + SLA, require security review for Private flows

Blockers / asks to AE / Solutions:
- Need updated pricing sheet for Dedicated burst option — pinged Jordan in Slack, awaiting file (JIRA-RGW-2451)
- Request: engineering one-pager on on-prem install time & infra prerequisites (for NovaHealth) — tag SRE / private-deployments

End-of-day wrap checklist:
- Update CRM: dispositions, next actions, meeting booked, stuck leads flagged
- Send follow-up emails for all connects today (template folder: Confluence -> Outreach/Templates)
- Add 1–2 learnings to team notes (what messaging worked)

Quick metrics snapshot (this week):
- Calls this week: 180 (target 200)
- Meetings booked: 12 (target 15)
- Conversion rate calls->meetings: 6.7%

Misc shorthand / notes to self:
- Try AB test subject lines: "Reduce LLM inference cost by 30%" vs "Lower LLM latency + cost — quick Q"
- Save Helix Labs quantization examples to my drive folder (link -> CONFLUENCE-Redwood-Outreach-Playbook)
- Reminder: prep demo runbook with Jordan before Friday's slot

Random thoughts / brainstorm:
- Run a short email campaign targeting data-platform leads about "Cost per inference" pain — include 1-sheeter on batching + caching
- Should we create a "compliance-first" one-pager that combines Private + KMS + audit logs? Tell product to prioritize if yes.

TODO (today):
- [ ] Call Park Financial (Ana) — aim for 9:15am
- [ ] Finalize Helix Labs follow-up packet
- [ ] Update CRM for Acme Retail
- [ ] Ping Jordan for Dedicated pricing sheet

Saved links / refs:
- Confluence: Outreach Playbook (internal)
- Jira: RGW-2451 (pricing sheet request)
- Slack thread: #sdr-outreach - note from Maya on fintech hooks
